title: Subjuntivo de valoración: es cuestionable que

sections.content: Es cuestionable que (it's questionable / debatable that) is an evaluative expression -- like es importante que or es lamentable que -- and always triggers the subjunctive, since it's judging a claim rather than asserting it as settled fact. It's the natural tool for a critical, analytical look at populism's mechanism. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Es cuestionable que este "pueblo" invocado constantemente por los líderes populistas corresponda realmente a toda la población de un país.
items.english: It's questionable whether this "people" constantly invoked by populist leaders really corresponds to a country's entire population.

items.spanish: Muchos politólogos consideran preocupante esta relación directa entre líder y masas, ya que tiende a debilitar los mecanismos institucionales de control.
items.english: Many political scientists consider this direct relationship between leader and masses concerning, since it tends to weaken institutional mechanisms of accountability.

items.spanish: Es también cuestionable que la radio resultara, en sí misma, un factor puramente neutral.
items.english: It's also questionable whether radio itself turned out to be a purely neutral factor.

items.spanish: Sería igualmente cuestionable que redujéramos el populismo latinoamericano a un simple fenómeno de manipulación de masas.
items.english: It would be equally questionable to reduce Latin American populism to a simple phenomenon of mass manipulation.

sections.content: Es cuestionable que + subjunctive expresses genuine, ongoing doubt -- contrast it with es evidente que or es un hecho que, both of which take the indicative because they assert something as settled rather than debatable.
